title: Reflected XSS through unescaped request data in TypoScript
root_cause: A TEXT object reads its value from GP: and renders it without htmlSpecialChars. The request value reaches the response body verbatim, so markup in the query string executes in the visitor's browser.

origin.reference: TYPO3 TypoScript Reference: stdWrap htmlSpecialChars; CLAUDE.md section 2
